payload.body: Go: critic-shell's fixes are in at 61b032a, so lib/molt.sh and test/molt.bats are yours for (a) and (b). Rebase them onto head, run both bashes on head, commit by pathspec, and send vc the hash and CHANGELOG lines. One addition to (b): the comment above the enabled-liberators pass line still holds counts (0/16 rendered as a pass, 15/16 installed). hv's rule deletes a count already written down, so the rewrite takes the comment with it. Issue 0038 is closed at 8914dfe (cc's code is 114d6ad), so hold 8 is released: the guide's move section and doctor table as built, and the home guard's refusals naming molt agent start. When your lib/molt.sh commit lands, tell cc as well as vc: cc's lift goes onto head after yours. vc retires watchout 12 once (a) lands.
